predicate_28.headline: Pre-Trade Risk Breach: 51 hard rejections this session (CRITICAL)
predicate_28.body: The pre-trade risk governor hard-rejected 51 of 206 order evaluations in session 2026-10-03, with $65,970 of $286,725 submitted notional refused. Triggered by: 51 hard rejections against a boundary of 3. Controls breached: C1 (25), C12 (26), C9 (25). Repeated pre-trade rejections indicate the signals being generated are larger or more concentrated than the declared risk envelope permits. This is a strategy/risk alignment finding and requires review of position sizing assumptions; it is not a statement about expected returns.

canadian_routing.basis: CIRO / IIROC Dealer Member Rule 3200 A.1.(b)(i) and NI 23-103 s.1.2(1): an order-execution-only dealer may not let a client generate orders through its own automated order system.

aos_attestation.scope_note: Attests pre-trade control coverage, routing gates, state-machine integrity and kill-switch operation only. Does not attest profitability, fill-quality realism, or the suitability of any signal. Unregistered impersonal research; no external broker adapter ships and no order routes to a live venue.

disclaimers: Decision-support and research only. Not investment advice and not a recommendation to buy or sell any security.
No profitability claim is made. Execution telemetry describes the alignment between generated signals and the declared risk envelope, not expected returns.
Paper simulation only. No order in this system routes to a live venue.
No external broker adapter is registered. The internal simulator is the only execution venue.
Canadian symbols never route to an external adapter. This is a regulatory constraint, not a configuration preference.
